h: Combined wealth of Dangote, Rabiu and Otedola reportedly rises to $73.1 billion
p: The combined fortunes of Nigeria's richest businessmen, Aliko Dangote, Abdulsamad Rabiu and Femi Otedola, have reportedly climbed to about $73.1 billion. The rise is said to be driven by gains in their listed companies and refining and energy interests.
more: Dangote remains the richest of the three by a wide margin.
The figures are estimates and move with share prices and exchange rates.
